cohort: The study included 80 mother-infant dyads with full-term infants (>=37 weeks gestation) from a tertiary care hospital, whose mothers intended to breastfeed and had no medical conditions affecting breastfeeding or infants with congenital anomalies.
finding: The LATCH scoring system effectively identified breastfeeding challenges, and targeted lactation support significantly improved LATCH scores.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was identified as a significant predictor of LATCH score improvement after intervention.
